actionbutton_guide:
📱 ACTION BUTTON (iPhone 15 Pro / 15 Pro Max / 16 and newer) — full step-by-step guide

WHAT YOU GET: press the Action Button → the iPhone records your voice → the bot recognizes it, saves the note and sends a confirmation to the chat.

PART 1 — GET THE LINK
1. Open the Mini App (the Open button in the bot).
2. At the bottom tap Settings (⚙).
3. Find "Voice add via Shortcuts" and turn the toggle ON.
4. Tap Copy — the link is now in your clipboard.

PART 2 — CREATE THE SHORTCUT
5. Open the "Shortcuts" app (pre-installed on iPhone).
6. Tap "+" (top right) → New Shortcut.
7. Tap "Add Action".
8. Search for "Record Audio" and select it.
9. In the Record Audio action → "Show More" → turn OFF "Show Recording".
10. Tap "Add Action" again.
11. Search for "Get Contents of URL" and select it.
12. In the URL field long-press → Paste (the link from PART 1).
13. Expand the action (small arrow) → "Show More":
    • Method → POST
    • Request Body → Form
14. Under Form tap "Add New Field":
    • Name → audio
    • Type → File
    • Value → "Select Variable" → "Recorded Audio" (result of step 8)
15. Tap Done (top right).
16. Long-press the shortcut in the list → Rename → QK NOTES.

PART 3 — TEST IT
17. In Shortcuts tap the QK NOTES shortcut once.
18. Allow microphone (first time only) and say something.
19. Open the bot chat — you should see "✅ Saved …" with your text.

PART 4 — BIND TO THE ACTION BUTTON
20. iPhone Settings → Action Button.
21. Scroll to "Shortcut".
22. "Choose a Shortcut…" → QK NOTES.

DONE! One press of the Action Button — and the note is in the bot.
Tip: if it doesn't work — toggle the switch in the Mini App again (PART 1), tap "New token" and update the URL in your shortcut.
backtap_guide:
📱 BACK TAP (iPhone 8 and newer) — full step-by-step guide

WHAT YOU GET: double (or triple) tap the back of your iPhone → voice recording → the bot saves the note and confirms in the chat.

PART 1 — GET THE LINK
1. Mini App → Settings (⚙) → "Voice add via Shortcuts".
2. Turn the toggle ON → tap Copy.

PART 2 — CREATE THE SHORTCUT
3. Open "Shortcuts" → "+" → New Shortcut.
4. Add Action → "Record Audio" (turn off "Show Recording").
5. Add Action → "Get Contents of URL" → paste the link into URL.
6. "Show More": Method = POST, Request Body = Form.
7. Field: name = audio, type = File, value = Recorded Audio.
8. Done → long-press the shortcut → Rename → QK NOTES.

PART 3 — TEST IT
9. Tap the QK NOTES shortcut once → allow microphone → say something.
10. The bot chat should show "✅ Saved …".

PART 4 — BIND TO BACK TAP
11. iPhone Settings → Accessibility → Touch.
12. Scroll to the very bottom → "Back Tap".
13. Pick "Double Tap" (or "Triple Tap").
14. In the shortcut list pick QK NOTES.

DONE! Double-tap the back of your phone (near the Apple logo) — the note is in the bot.
Tip: tap quickly and firmly; if it triggers accidentally — use Triple Tap.
